description: This Java class 'CreateCalendarCommandHandler' handles 'CREATE' commands for calendars within the Fineract platform. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates calendar creation to the 'CalendarWritePlatformService'. The class is annotated as a Spring service and uses dependency injection for its service dependency.

classes.name: CreateCalendarCommandHandler
classes.description: This class handles 'CREATE' commands for calendar entities, implementing the processCommand method to invoke the calendar creation service.

methods.name: CreateCalendarCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the CalendarWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to create a calendar by delegating to the write platform service.
